image.caption: The Supreme Court of Canada in Ottawa. (Benoit Roussel/Radio-Canada)

blocks.text: The ruling comes in the case of a Mi'kmaw man with severe mental health challenges who was sentenced in Nova Scotia to five years in prison after pleading guilty to aggravated assault against his partner, a Mi'kmaw woman.
Supreme Court of Canada rules on appeal involving Mi'kmaw offender and victim from N.S.
